selection.standalone_rule: dev arrival catches desc, false alerts asc, seed std asc, feature count asc, all-training first
selection.secondary_rule: dev IF-branch catches desc, IF false alerts asc, seed std asc, feature count asc, all-training first
selection.policy_rule: reserved must catch more fraud with no extra false alerts in every seed on dev

methodology: Feature selection uses train labels; normal-only uses confirmed train negatives. Both are label-informed.
